name: VlasovAmpereOneSpecies scaling (numpy)
description:
6D full-orbit Vlasov-Ampere test particles in a homogeneous cube, used as a second CuPy
multi-GPU/multi-rank strong-scaling case alongside GuidingCenter -- deliberately not
dominated by mpi_sort_markers, since VlasovAmpereCoupling solves a real linear system
each step on top of the particle push.

custom_commands: echo "Running profiling case: vlasovampere_cpu_node_vs_gpu_node (256 MPI ranks)"
echo "Description: Vlasov--Ampere on a cube, run across one full CPU node (NumPy) vs one full GPU node (CuPy) at the same marker count."
echo "Physics problem: Electrostatic Vlasov--Ampere; the particle push and the particle-to-field accumulation hot loops."
echo "Completed profiling case: vlasovampere_cpu_node_vs_gpu_node (256 MPI ranks)"
